items.name: grand-library
items.text: a grand two-tier library hall, ladders sliding on brass rails, green-shaded reading lamps pooling light down the long oak tables

items.name: industrial-loft
items.text: a raw industrial loft, riveted steel trusses over pale brick, oversize factory windows gridding light across a worn plank floor

items.name: cloister-walk
items.text: a vaulted cloister walk wrapped around a garden garth, column shadows striping the worn flagstones

items.name: capsule-hotel
items.text: a glowing capsule-hotel corridor, stacked sleeping pods with rounded hatches, cool light strips receding in perfect perspective

items.name: orangerie
items.text: a light-flooded orangerie, white iron ribs and fogged glass over potted citrus trees, condensation beading down the panes

items.name: wine-cellar
items.text: a candlelit vaulted wine cellar, dusty bottles sleeping in stone bays, wax drips fossilized down the sconces

items.name: japanese-tearoom
items.text: a spare tatami tearoom, a single scroll and one flower in the alcove, paper-diffused light through shoji

items.name: grand-staircase
items.text: a sweeping marble double staircase, brass handrail polished bright by a century of hands, the chandelier dropping crystal glitter three storeys down the stairwell

items.name: artist-atelier
items.text: a paint-spattered artist atelier under tall north-light windows, canvases stacked six deep, brushes blooming from jars

items.name: observatory-dome
items.text: inside an observatory dome, the great telescope aimed through the open slit, riveted catwalks circling the dark

items.name: mid-century-lounge
items.text: a sunken mid-century lounge, teak paneling and a stone fireplace wall, low leather seating ringing the conversation pit

items.name: server-hall
items.text: a humming server hall, status LEDs receding in disciplined rows, cold-aisle floor grilles breathing

items.name: scandinavian-room
items.text: a Scandinavian living room, pale oak floor and white walls, low wool-upholstered furniture, one black-framed window of cool even light

items.name: wabi-sabi-room
items.text: a wabi-sabi room of cracked clay plaster and weathered timber, a single dried branch in a stoneware vase, raking light honoring every imperfection

items.name: art-nouveau-salon
items.text: an art-nouveau salon, whiplash-curved walnut paneling, stained-glass dragonfly transoms, wallpaper twining with stylized stems

items.name: baroque-hall
items.text: a baroque state hall, gilded stucco scrollwork framing a fresco sky, mirrored arcades doubling candlelight down waxed parquet

items.name: moroccan-riad
items.text: a Moroccan riad courtyard, carved cedar galleries above zellige-tiled walls, one shaft of light reaching the central fountain

items.name: cathedral-nave
items.text: a limestone cathedral nave, clustered piers rising into ribbed vaults, stained glass laying colored panes across the stone floor

items.name: marble-bathhouse
items.text: a marble thermal bathhouse, steam drifting through high shafts of light, brass taps and still green water doubling the columns

items.name: art-deco-pool
items.text: an art-deco swimming hall, emerald tiles running to the waterline, chrome ladder rails, light from the arched windows wobbling in caustic nets across the vaulted ceiling

items.name: opera-auditorium
items.text: a horseshoe opera auditorium, four gilded balcony tiers lined in red velvet, plaster putti over the proscenium, the great chandelier hanging in its own hush

items.name: column-cistern
items.text: an underground cistern, a forest of salvaged marble columns standing in shallow black water, every capital doubled by its reflection, the far rows dissolving into dark
